text: I think you'll really enjoy the Caribbean Fruity Chicken Salad! It's a refreshing and light dish that incorporates your love of chicken and salad, and it fits within your time budget. The combination of flavors and textures from the bananas, pineapple, mandarin oranges, and coconut will provide a nice change of pace from your usual meals. Plus, it's surprisingly low in sodium, which aligns with your health goal. Give it a try and see how you like it!
